candidates.name: Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis (HLH)
support_spans: bone marrow smear and tissue showed trilineage hematopoiesis with histiocytes and hemophagocytosis
Groups of apoptotic bodies, abundant pink cytoplasmic fragments and small blue dots of fragmented nuclei in confluent necroptosis area
Markedly expanded paracortex (CD3+ T cells), limited CD20+ B cells in residual reactive follicles, positive CD68 and myeloperoxidase in histiocytes
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results, including fever, lymphadenopathy, and hemophagocytosis in the bone marrow, are consistent with HLH.

candidates.name: Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis
support_spans: Bone marrow smear and tissue showed trilineage hematopoiesis with histiocytes and hemophagocytosis
Groups of apoptotic bodies, abundant pink cytoplasmic fragments and small blue dots of fragmented nuclei in confluent necroptosis area
candidates.why: The presence of hemophagocytosis in the bone marrow and necroptosis in the lymph node biopsy are characteristic findings of Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis.

candidates.name: Influenza A infection
support_spans: One of his classmates was known to have influenza A infection
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and the known exposure to a classmate with influenza A infection suggest a possible diagnosis of Influenza A infection.

candidates.name: Subarachnoid hemorrhage or CNS infection
support_spans: Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed: - Nucleated cells count: 454 (0-5) ×106/L, with 75% mononuclear cells - Protein level: 4001 (150-450) mg/L
candidates.why: The significantly elevated nucleated cell count and protein level in the cerebrospinal fluid are indicative of a CNS infection or subarachnoid hemorrhage.

candidates.name: Infectious Meningitis
support_spans: Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed:       - Nucleated cells count: 454 (0-5) ×106/L, with 75% mononuclear cells
Leptomeninges thickening and enhancement observed in contrast-enhanced T1 weighted image
candidates.why: The elevated nucleated cell count in the cerebrospinal fluid and the leptomeningeal enhancement on MRI suggest Infectious Meningitis.

candidates.name: Systemic Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis
support_spans: unremitting fever with peak temperature over 40°C and simultaneous headache for 6 days
cervical and inguinal lymphadenopathy with maximum diameter of 15mm
candidates.why: The combination of high fever, lymphadenopathy, and the presence of antinuclear antibodies are consistent with Systemic Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis.

selector.rationale: Bone marrow smear showed trilineage hematopoiesis with histiocytes and hemophagocytosis, and lymph node biopsy revealed features consistent with HLH, such as apoptotic bodies and expanded paracortex with CD3+ T cells.

rejected.label: Systemic Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings like rash, eye involvement, or typical joint symptoms

rejected.label: Influenza A infection
rejected.why: No direct evidence of influenza infection in the patient, only a classmate was known to have it

rejected.label: Subarachnoid hemorrhage or CNS infection
rejected.why: Cerebrospinal fluid analysis and imaging findings are more consistent with HLH and infectious meningitis
